title: German Beef Wrap
description: A German-inspired twist on the classic beef wrap. Sliced beef is served in a light, fluffy wrap with russian mustard and topped with fresh herbs.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Season the sirloin steak with salt and pepper.
Grill the steak for 3-4 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 135°F for medium-rare.
Let the steak rest for 5 minutes before slicing it thinly against the grain.
Meanwhile, toast the light, fluffy wrap on the grill or in a toaster.
Spread russian mustard on the wrap, leaving a small border around the edges.
Add sliced onion and fresh parsley on top of the mustard.
Slice the grilled steak and place it on top of the onion and parsley.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
